item.title: Battlefield 6 Season 2 delayed until February, but more content for Season 1 and events are on the way
item.description: Following a strong launch back in October, Battlefield 6 unleashed a notable first season of content, which was expected to end around 20th January. However, following heated feedback, EA and Battlefield Studios are saying Season 2 will now arrive in February. Read more

item.description: Josef Fares, known for his outspoken and often expletive laden thoughts (remember that Oscars rant?), has now shared his opinion on one of the moment's hottest topics: AI. Read more

item.title: Ubisoft reportedly cuts jobs at Abu Dhabi studio as company-wide layoffs continue to hit staff
item.description: We're only two weeks into 2026, but the new year hasn't been kind to Ubisoft employees. Right after the closure of Ubisoft Halifax and layoffs at Massive Entertainment and Ubisoft Stockholm, roles are reportedly being cut at Ubisoft Abu Dhabi too. Read more

item.title: Fallout veteran Ron Perlman says he was paid "40 dollars and a sandwich" for his voiceover work in the original game
item.description: Right now, Fallout is one of the largest video game franchises around. Amazon's highly successful TV show only took the series popularity to the next level. However, before Bethesda decided to take things in a different direction after acquiring the series from Black Isle Studios and Interplay Entertainment, the series wasn't nearly as famous. In fact, veteran narrator Ron Perlman has revealed his first payment for work on the games was hilariously meager. Read more

item.title: Umamusume developer apologises after AI studio backlash, says it will not use generative AI "without prior notice"
item.description: Japanese video game developer Cygames has released a new statement regarding its use of AI, after last week announcing its intention to create an AI-focused subsidiary company, which stirred up a certain amount of discourse. Read more

item.title: Forza Horizon 6's release date might have been revealed early, and it's allegedly coming sooner than anticipated
item.description: A new Developer Direct stream from Xbox is happening next week, and with it we'll get a "deep dive" into Forza Horizon 6. This is the previously announced next entry in the open-world driving series, which will take us to Japan. However, a surprise may have been spoiled early. Read more

item.title: Hytale's early access launch isn't quite ready to step out of Minecraft's shadow, but as a block-loving survival fan I'm still having a blast
item.description: I did not anticipate it'd take me an hour to start my first game of Hytale after loading it up, but you can thank its surprisingly involved character creator for that. Eventually,though - after fashioning a blonde 'tashed, barechested, leather-clad lothario who swings a little more 'porn star' than I was aiming for - I finally went in, and the positive impressions continued. Read more
